patch.value: GH-1118: natural-language word-number titles trigger duplicate issue-code false positives
The duplicate issue-code title heuristic treats prose such as Match-3, Covid-19, or Wi-Fi-6 as tracker identifiers and emits an impossible rename-or-merge remediation for unrelated items.

The classifier distinguishes prose compounds from evidence-backed issue identifiers without maintaining an unbounded dictionary; negative controls retain detection for real uppercase and configured code formats; validation output explains the evidence and recovery path; focused tests cover Match-3, Covid-19, Wi-Fi-6, real codes, mixed case, body evidence, and configured formats; the full validation and 100 percent coverage gates pass.
Create two unrelated items whose titles contain the same natural-language word-number token such as Match-3, then run pm validate --check-metadata.
Natural-language compounds are not classified as logical issue codes; true structured issue codes and genuine collisions remain detected with actionable evidence.
The generic title regex groups unrelated prose tokens as issue codes and recommends dishonest renames or merges.
